findings.issue: Access control, storage, fastening and ordinary provisioning can occur without a custody transfer or a work obligation. They must not silently supply the labels whose association with documents is to be tested.

findings.resolution: The current drafts require a reproducible physical custody-change criterion independent of tested sealing occurrence and an additional observable work-specific distinction. They correctly leave operational criteria and power to a new discovery pilot.

conclusion: The source/date/denominator core supports an exploratory eligibility report. Named activities and ordered architectural changes are positive results. Preferential persistence, institutional scale, custody transfer and labour-specific document use remain unestablished. Resolve the residual summary/function wording, retain the corrected prospective construct gates, and preserve the Kanmer findings as post-freeze leads.
